text:
Jamie (Sales): Passing WillowCrest to CS — contract signed. Short context: enterprise, private deployment (customer VPC), Okta SSO, EMEA data residency, requested KMS/BYOK and SOC2 artifacts. Renewal in ~9 months. They asked for Dedicated sizing and an 8-week onboarding plan.
Maya (CS): Got it. I'll own the onboarding. Need SKU, committed qps, and whether customer will manage the VPC or want us to provision.
Jamie (Sales): SKU: WIL-ENT-2026. Committed baseline 4k req/day, bursts up to ~50 req/s. Customer will provide VPC and prefers peering. Budget contact: Claire Bowen (CFO) — intro sent.
Ava (Solutions Eng): Rough sizing: 50 req/s with 8s median suggests ~400 concurrent tokens. Recommend start with 2 x A40-equivalent nodes + autoscale to 4 for peaks. Will produce a capacity estimate and cost delta by EOD.
Omar (Sec Eng): KMS/BYOK and HSM access needed — that'll require a short design doc and runbook for key rotation and access controls. Estimate 1 week of effort to validate patterns.
Priya (Support): I'll draft a support runbook (triage steps, paging list, SLA handoffs) and an oncall schedule for cutover. Need primary Eng oncall for the window.
Liza (Customer Ops): I'll track renewal risk. Flags: CFO procurement means tighter review; EMEA residency brings legal review for data processing addendum. Label renewal risk = medium-high; create 6-month cadence for touchpoints.
Jamie (Sales): Procurement expects 2-4 weeks for network approvals. They asked for a simple preflight checklist for their IT. Pasting starter below.
Jamie (Sales): ```
# WillowCrest preflight checklist
- VPC CIDR, proposed /20 or larger
- Peering routes: allow TCP 443 to our connector IPs
- Okta SAML metadata or OIDC issuer URL
- Firewall: outbound to control-plane IPs (see contract appendix)
- KMS info: ARN or HSM contact
```
Maya (CS): Plan for canary cutover: week 1 staging & smoke, week 2 10% traffic, week 3 full. Metrics to gate: SSO auth success, P50/P95 latency, error rate <0.5%, token cost per 1k.
Ava (Solutions Eng): Canary makes sense. We'll keep a hosted fallback route for 2 weeks. Also propose a quantized model variant if latency and quality meet thresholds to save cost.
Omar (Sec Eng): For SOC2 evidence, we can provide standard artifacts. If they request extra encryption attestations, security/legal will need to sign off — add ~2 weeks.
Priya (Support): I'll schedule a 60-min dry run two weeks before cutover with our oncall and WillowCrest IT. Also will prepare a rollback checklist.
deploy-bot: Deployment windows available: 03/25 02:00-05:00 UTC and 03/26 22:00-01:00 UTC; reserve slot? :calendar:
Liza (Customer Ops): Tentatively reserve 03/25 slot. Also created renewal alert at month 6 to start the commercial playbook.
Jamie (Sales): One more operational risk: usage spikes if they batch inference jobs. Recommend quota guardrails for first 30 days and clear alerting.
Maya (CS): Adding traffic guardrails to onboarding checklist and a customer dashboard link for usage.
Ava (Solutions Eng): I'll attach a test prompt suite and evaluation set for regression monitoring during rollout.
Omar (Sec Eng): @Omar available for primary during cutover; needs backup. @Priya will be backup for paging.
Priya (Support): Confirmed as backup. I'll own the support paging list and post-cutover incident triage for first 72 hours.
Maya (CS): Action owners summary (deliverables + due dates):
- Maya: Full onboarding deck + timeline by Tue 03/12
- Ava: Dedicated sizing + cost estimate by EOD
- Omar: KMS/HSM feasibility + effort estimate by Fri
- Priya: Support runbook + oncall handover template by Mon
- Liza: Renewal watch + 6-month playbook by next Wed
- Jamie: Provide IT network engineer contact (already intro'd Claire)
Maya (CS): Acceptance criteria for go-live: successful SSO auth, VPC peering verified, KMS/BYOK verified, latency within agreed P95, signed IT acceptance from WillowCrest.
Jamie (Sales): Claire, looping you for visibility. Expect CS kickoff invite with timeline and owners.
Maya (CS): I'll post the formal handoff doc here when ready. Closing note: we'll run weekly syncs for first 8 weeks and monitor the renewal risk closely.
